purpose: Close topology-support and invariant-test coverage for 4+ rider lines without retuning C1/N1, ranking architectures, or making real-world effect/frequency claims.

allowed: add an explicit forced line-shape interface for synthetic engineering fixtures
generate PRE-consistent line_group_id/line_position/line_size/is_singleton fields for long lines
test ordered-top3 world support/mass only as mechanical compatibility
prohibited: assign a new real-truth bonus to fourth-or-deeper positions
claim 4-rider or 5-rider lines are stronger/weaker in real keirin
reuse the consumed PR3 holdout for rescue tuning

topology_support_vs_effect_assumption.topology_support: A layout can be represented and mechanically tested.
topology_support_vs_effect_assumption.effect_assumption: Any synthetic utility consequence remains a scenario assumption and is not validated by topology support.

forced_fixture_motifs.claim_limit: Motifs are support fixtures, not measured frequencies. Exact 7-rider 4-3 frequency/existence is not promoted beyond current evidence.

fail_closed_invariants: all requested line sizes are positive integers
requested line sizes sum exactly to field size
every active car belongs to exactly one line
line positions are exactly 0 through line_size-1 within each line
reported line_size is identical for all members of a line
default generator behavior remains unchanged when no override is supplied
STANDARD_FI_FII_7 and SPECIAL_9 field-size guards remain unchanged

allowed_assertions: ordered-top3 support has no duplicate finishers
mechanical_world_check.forbidden_interpretation: No architecture winner, effect size, frequency, calibration, or real-edge inference from these fixtures.
